user.title: Select an RF transmitter
user.description: Choose the radio used to send Dooya commands at 433.934 MHz.

receiver.title: Select an optional RF receiver
receiver.description: Choose a receiver to learn the remote and observe physical button presses, or continue with manual setup. The receiver must already be tuned for your 433 MHz OOK remote.

retry.title: Remote not learned
retry.description: No confirmed Dooya press was received, or the receiver became unavailable. Retry with an available receiver, or enter the remote ID manually.

manual.title: Enter the remote ID
manual.description: Enter the ID of the remote already paired with your blinds.

data_description.remote_id: Decimal or hexadecimal with a 0x prefix (for example, 0x00123C14).

finish.title: Number of channels
finish.description: Enter the number of numbered channels on your remote. A received channel does not indicate how many channels exist. Channel 0 is broadcast and is excluded.

reconfigure.title: Change RF transmitter or receiver
reconfigure.description: Keep the remote identity, entities and frequency setting while changing its radios. Choosing a receiver here does not learn a different remote.

error.invalid_remote_id: Enter a remote ID between 0 and 16777215, in decimal or hexadecimal with a 0x prefix.
error.invalid_channels: Enter a whole number of channels between 1 and 255.
error.invalid_transmitter: Select a compatible 433.934 MHz OOK transmitter.
error.receiver_unusable: Select an available receiver or continue without a receiver.

abort.no_transmitters: Add an RF transmitter to Home Assistant before setting up Dooya RF.
abort.no_compatible_transmitters: No RF transmitter supports 433.934 MHz with OOK modulation.

progress.listening: Press Stop on the physical remote. Listening for repeated Dooya frames for up to 30 seconds. Nothing is transmitted while learning.

init.title: Dooya carrier frequency
init.description: Requested RF frequency for this remote. OpenHARF applies the radio’s existing crystal calibration.

error.invalid_frequency: Enter a whole-number frequency in Hz between 1 and 4294967295.
error.unsupported_frequency: The selected transmitter does not support this frequency with OOK modulation, or is no longer available.
